page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture. The system is provisioned with 104 dedicated vCPUs driven by 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processors. It is paired with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing an allocation of approximately 1.85 GB per vCPU. This configuration aligns with compute-intensive workloads that prioritize core density over massive memory per thread.

Network infrastructure on the instance delivers a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput node-to-node communication. The instance does not feature local ephemeral storage or integrated GPU hardware accelerators, necessitating external network-attached block storage for persistent data and disk I/O operations. Public IPv4 connectivity is not bundled by default.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high compute core concentration allows organizations to consolidate heavy CPU workloads into fewer system footprints. The absence of built-in storage and GPUs streamlines resource expenditure directly toward raw CPU execution. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.26xlarge is suitable for batch processing pipelines, large-scale distributed compilation, continuous integration build clusters, high-concurrency web serving, and parallel scientific modeling tasks that rely strictly on CPU compute.

Given its dense multi-core design and lower RAM-to-CPU ratio, the ecs.c6.26xlarge provides a cost-efficient deployment profile for highly threaded and CPU-bound workloads, including distributed build systems, large web application backends, batch compute workers, and scientific simulation software.
